CLOSE_ABANDONED.description: Close if: no activity >180 days AND no LP label AND not approved

CLOSE_SUPERSEDED.description: Close if: explicitly marked as superseded or duplicate in body/comments

MIXED_INTENT.description: Flag if: PR title/body suggests multiple unrelated intents (feat+fix, docs+refactor spanning multiple packages)

NORMALIZE_TITLE.description: Ensure PR title follows conventional commits format if possible
